request.query: integer Hasse derivative determinant separated product index upper bound l times Theta

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv
items.type:
(R : Type u_2) →
  {V : Type u_3} →
    [inst : AddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : Semiring R] → [inst_2 : Module R V] → ℕ → LaurentSeries V →ₗ[R] LaurentSeries V

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f g : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (f * g) =
    ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal k, (Polynomial.hasseDeriv ij.1) f * (Polynomial.hasseDeriv ij.2) g

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Chebyshev.theta_le_log4_mul_x
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → Chebyshev.theta x ≤ Real.log 4 * x
